title: Dirab fayxih xisô mahandas
intro: kaxxa reedanti weelo inki adda ayfaf taceem aydaadul kaxxam yamixxige qanxaffe luk dumaahi Masril. Tama numtin amoh amri audacious command — jannatal diggoysaanam faxximta xisne xisaanam. Ken aydaadi Qur'aanak inti maleelah ammirtimiyya kaxxiini dubuk finqa fan beytaamih qasiiritte kinnim qaddoysa.
clues: Anu cokmi buxal ayfaf ece caylale miraacay ardi bagul rabbiinu yoh essera.
Anu fayyale malaakih arac yibbixeh suge, inni waktil kaxxam kaxxiinale qanxaffe le fayseh suge.
Yi miraacini Muusah Yallal gexkalit luk suge, oson mamaxxaga yaceenim cineenih.
Anu giral alaysen xaaahih kalqat xisam amriseh sugeeh, tohih taagah yi amoyti qaran fanah yawqem duudah.
kalqat qaran magufinnaay, yi ayfaafay kaxxiina amotani qaybi yoh bahte.
Anu kattaate num lih rabeeh, yi migaq qanxaffeleela xiqsiisa marak sarrimaane le maabitina yekke.
